title.narrative: Integrated support to the most vulnerable and conflict-affected populations in the Eastern and Northern Oblasts of Ukraine

description.narrative: ltpgtThis proposed project will directly contribute to the objectives of UHF ltbgtMultisectoral Priority 2lt/bgt on ‘revitailizing community infrastructure and providing comprehensive shelter/NFI and protection assistance at the household level’, andltbgt Single Sector Priority 1lt/bgt on ‘comprehensive protection, GBV and mine action services in conflict-affected regions’, as well as with the ltbgtstrategic objectives for 2024 HRPlt/bgt. DRC’s proposed interventions address the priorities of the Allocation through an integrated, multi-sector response to meet the protection (GBV, HLP and mine action), shelter, food security and livelihood needs of ltbgtltugt259,920lt/ugtlt/bgt most vulnerable, and conflict affected people. To maximize impact, interventions across different sectors and priority areas are linked and will cover similar raions prioritized by the clusters within Kharkivska, Zaporzhizhia, Sumska, Chernihivska, Dnipropetrovska and Donetska Oblasts. ltbrgt ltbrgtltbgtDRC, together with five local protection partnerslt/bgt (League of Modern Women, Alliance Global, Caritas Kharkiv, Positive Women and Dialogue of Communities), will provide comprehensive protection services to meet individual and community needs in target frontline areas and areas of return, including case management, legal assistance, psychosocial support, community-based protection, individual protection assistance, referrals to specialized services, support to women and girls’ safe spaces, GBV awareness raising, capacity development of service providers and protection monitoring. Protection responses will be integrated with shelter and livelihood activities, prioritizing persons and households with compounded needs and whose protection risks are exacerbated due to damaged shelters and destroyed livelihoods, particularly agriculture and livestock activities. Furthemore, this project is designed to contribute to all three cluster objectives of Protection – Mine Action through EORE, provision of Victim Assistance (VA) services, and deploying and demining Non-Technical Surveys (NTS) in Kharkivska, Donetska, Sumska, Dnipropetrovska and Zaphorzhizhia Oblasts. ltbrgt ltbrgtAll proposed activities are based on the current needs of existing protection monitoring databases and assessments of targeted raions and are directly in line with cluster and sub-cluster standards and priorities ltigtltbgt(attached Email Endorsements from the Clusters)lt/bgtlt/igt. Implementing the proposed activities will also prioritize the meaningful engagement and involvement of local partners consistent with UHF’s localization agenda. Protection and inclusion concerns will be mainstreamed across all sector responses, and an integrated targeting approach will be utilized to ensure that both sectoral and vulnerability targeting is prioritized across the entirety of the intervention. As a result, the intervention will comprehensively meet the multisector needs of the most vulnerable conflict affected populations in the target oblasts. ltbrgtlt/pgt
